# capi_move (Action)

`clusterctl move`: carry every CAPI object of a namespace, with what they own (Hardware, rufio Machines, Workflows, HelmChartProxies and the rest), from one management cluster to another whose providers are already installed. Clusters are paused on the source and resumed on the target by clusterctl. The source defaults to the management cluster the provider block names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Move a namespace's CAPI objects to another management cluster whose
# providers are already installed (capi_provider resources against it).
action "capi_move" "to_new_management" {
  config {
    namespace     = "capi"
    to_kubeconfig = var.new_management_kubeconfig
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `to_kubeconfig` (String) Kubeconfig content of the target management cluster.

### Optional

- `from_kubeconfig` (String) Kubeconfig content of the source management cluster. Default: the provider block's.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Default `default`.
